name: Minase Hatsune
source:
Hatsune, is same grade with [url=/c10765]Kaoruko[/url], entered the dormitory building a year ago. Her parents went to New York because of her father's job, and she had to stay in Japan. 
Hatsune is timid, so she was a little afraid of Kaoruko last year. Also, she is [url=/c10771]Yuu[/url]'s caring onee-sama.
She joined the track and field club due to an admiration for Yukari, her former onee-sama (who graduated last year). This year she becomes the student council president in succession to Yukari and a finalist for the seventy-fifth elder sister.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
